ghost.sample: Zog was a small dragon. He lived behind the moon. He ate clouds, and he loved them. One day, the moon was behind dark rain. Zog saw no clouds near his home. He felt worried. "Oh no," he said. He flew to the moon's side and looked down. A little girl named Lily was on a soft cloud. She was scared. "I want to go home," she said. Zog went close and smiled. "I can help," he said. He let Lily hold his tail. Zog flew slow and safe. The rain stopped. A fluffy cloud came by. Zog ate the cloud, and Lily laughed. Then they saw Lily's house far away. Zog took her there. Lily waved and said, "Thank you." Zog went back behind the moon. He ate one more cloud there and felt happy.

Zog was a small dragon. He lived behind the moon. He ate clouds and did not eat anything else. One day, Zog wanted a cloud for his friend Ben. Ben was a bird who lived near a hill. Zog flew down from behind the moon and looked all around. He saw a fluffy cloud over the hill. "That one looks good," said Ben. Zog nodded. He flew up, but a wind came and moved the cloud away. Zog tried again. The wind was strong, and Zog was slow. Ben said, "You can do it." Zog smiled and tried one more time. At last, he bit the cloud. It was soft and sweet. Ben laughed. Zog laughed too. They sat on the hill and looked at the sky. Then Zog went back behind the moon. He felt warm and proud.

Sisi was a little cloud. Sisi lived in the sky. Sisi liked to sing songs.  
One day, the sky was gray and sad. Sisi felt lonely. Sisi wanted a friend.  
Then a small bird came near. The bird was wet from rain.  
"Can I stay with you?" asked the bird.  
"Yes," said Sisi.  
Sisi sang a song, and the bird shook off the rain. The song was soft and sweet.  
The bird felt warm and happy. It sat near Sisi and listened. Then it sang too.  
Soon, the gray sky did not feel sad at all. It felt calm and kind.  
Sisi and the bird sang together. They sang loud, then soft, then loud again.  
The bird flew around Sisi and came back.  
Sisi felt happy. Sisi lived in the sky and had a new friend. They sang songs until the sun came out.

Sisi was a little cloud. Sisi lived in the sky. Sisi liked to sing songs. One day, Sisi saw a girl named Lily on a hill. Lily looked sad. She had lost her toy bird. Sisi felt sorry. "Where did it go?" said Sisi. Lily looked up. Sisi sang a soft song. The song was happy and warm. Then a bird flew down from a tree. It was the toy bird. Lily smiled big. "Thank you," she said. Sisi felt proud. Lily waved up at the sky. Sisi sang again, and the bird sang too. They made a very nice sound. The day felt soft and good. Sisi stayed in the sky and sang songs until the sun went down. Lily went home happy. Sisi was happy too.

Pip was a tiny robot. Pip loved red apples. Pip slept in a teapot.  
At home one morning, Pip looked in the kitchen.  
He saw a bowl with three red apples.  
Pip smiled so big. "My apples," he said.  
Then mom said, "Let's make a snack."  
Pip helped wash one apple. He tried hard and did it well.  
Then he saw dad by the door. Dad looked tired.  
Pip gave dad a red apple. Dad smiled. "Thank you, Pip."  
Pip felt warm inside.  
Then Pip and mom sat at the table and ate apple pieces.  
It was a very nice time.  
Later, Pip went to his teapot bed.  
He slept in the teapot and dreamed of the kitchen, and the three red apples, and happy faces.

Pip was a tiny robot. Pip loved red apples. Pip slept in a teapot. One day, Pip and Sam went to the beach. The sand was soft and warm. Pip saw a red apple in a basket near a chair. He wanted it. But a wave came close and shook the basket. The apple rolled out. "Oh no," said Sam. Pip ran fast. He saw the red apple near a rock. But it was stuck in some wet sand. Pip used both hands and pulled it out. Sam smiled. "You are brave," he said. Pip felt glad. Then a bird came by and looked at the apple. Pip gave the bird a tiny bit of apple skin. The bird hopped away. Pip ate the red apple and looked at the blue sea. That night he went home, climbed into his teapot, and slept.
